roadworks.description: Load restrictions to Ilkley Rd Overpass (Over Bruce Highway) at Tanawha
roadworks.impact: Subject to a 5 tonne GVM limit
roadworks.information: All Trucks and Buses Prohibited. What to expect: Signage, changed traffic conditions, temporary infrastructure and CCTV on the approaches to the Ilkley Road overpass to support compliance with restrictions. The Ilkley Road overpass over the Bruce Highway at Tanawha is currently operating under restrictions. Please comply with these restrictions for safety.

roadworks.description: Sections of the Sunshine Motorway, Nicklin Way and Kawana Way.
roadworks.information: • Early works have commenced for the Mooloolah River Interchange (MRI) Upgrade Stage 1, including site preparation, clearing, service relocations and geotechnical investigations to prepare for major earthworks in 2026, prior to main construction. • Daytime works will be between 7am and 6pm (Monday to Friday), with occasional weekend work. • Some nightworks will be undertaken between 6pm and 6am, including occasional weekends. This may include ramp and road closures which will be signed prior to closures. • Reduced speed limits, construction signage and traffic control will be present. • Potential delays due to temporary lane closures and redirections may occur. • Potential construction noise, light, vibration and dust may be experienced within the project footprint. • The active transport pathway on Seriata Way has now been permanently closed. • The public carpark on Brisbane Road (via Incana Court) has now been permanently closed
roadworks.provided_by: Department of Transport and Main Roads

roadworks.information: The Department of Transport and Main Roads’ (TMR) contractor will be undertaking a safety improvements project at the Maroochydore-Noosa Road (David Low Way) and Mudjimba Esplanade intersection, Marcoola. • Construction will be done as a combination of day and night works with day works between 6am and 6pm and night works between 6pm and 6am. Note, some weekend work may also be required. • Changed traffic conditions including reduced speed limits, lane closures, roadworks signage and traffic controllers will be in place to ensure motorist and roadworker safety. • A significant pedestrian detour will be required to accommodate the works. The detour route will be in place for up to eight weeks. The route will be signed and traffic controllers will be on site to assist during working hours. • TMR will engage with nearby residents, accommodation and hospitality venues ahead of and during active construction.
roadworks.provided_by: Department of Transport and Main Roads
